single 112 service activated 29 March 2018 per the Moldovan government's own gov.md announcement, which states the prior separate numbers 901 (police), 902 (fire) and 903 (ambulance) ran in parallel only until late June 2018 before redirecting to 112, corroborated by ipn.md's contemporaneous report headlined '901, 902, 903 no longer active'. Moldova's official language is Romanian per the Constitutional Court's 2013 ruling and the Parliament's 2023 law replacing 'Moldovan language' with 'Romanian language' throughout the country's laws, which is why it is included in this pack's regions rather than only Romania
